snippet.title: FEE3 2024: Iron Emblem Gaiden by knabepicer
snippet.description:
Iron Emblem Gaiden is a game inspired by the original Iron Emblem, with generic, no-name playable characters, and gameplay built around an ironman style of no resetting. 
New features include a commander swap system to ensure that no matter who dies, there will always be someone to lead, and a map overview that indicates reinforcements, treasure, and other key info during a chapter.
https://feuniverse.us/t/fe8-iron-emblem-gaiden/17933

Trailer by TrikkiNikki
